load_or_save_cases.state_effect: Accepted state and canonical checkpoint both remain valid.
Accepted physical state remains authoritative; no cutback and no false success.
No state is installed; expose persisted and recomputed digest diagnostics.

retry_policy.checkpoint_failure: NON_RETRYABLE_BY_DEFAULT; infrastructure retry requires an explicit storage policy and must not become physical cutback.
retry_policy.load_validation_failure: NON_RETRYABLE; reject before opening a trial.
retry_policy.state_corruption: NON_RETRYABLE; stop and preserve the offending artifact for diagnosis.

distinction: CHECKPOINT_FAILURE describes failure while producing/persisting a valid accepted state; INPUT_VALIDATION_ERROR describes an absent, unsupported or model-incompatible input; STATE_CORRUPTION describes a present checkpoint whose accepted-state integrity or finite-value contract is violated.
